Definition: from G473 and the middle voice of G3670; to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise:--give thanks.
BiblicalUsage: Anna the prophetess gives thanks to the Lord over the child Jesus, answering the praise of Simeon with her own. The word means to answer in praise, to confess in turn, as one voice answers another.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for answering praise carries no doctrine of its own; its beauty is Anna's, that an old woman's thanks answered Simeon's song over the child.
RelatedEvents: The Presentation of Jesus in the Temple
